lessons.title: Future Plans

items.example: Ich habe nächste Woche Zeit.
items.exampleMeaning: I have time next week.

items.example: Wir treffen uns am Montag.
items.exampleMeaning: We meet on Monday.

items.example: Ich möchte dich einladen.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to invite you.

items.example: Kann ich einen Film vorschlagen?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I suggest a movie?

items.example: Um wie viel Uhr beginnt das Treffen?
items.exampleMeaning: At what time does the meeting start?

items.example: Ja, gerne! Ich komme.
items.exampleMeaning: Yes, gladly! I will come.

lessons.tip: In German, the days of the week are always in the accusative case when you say 'on'. For example, use 'am Montag' (on Monday).

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, gerne! Um wie viel Uhr?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I would like to invite you.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a friend making plans.
scenario.brief: Ask when you will meet and suggest a day. Confirm the time.
scenario.goal: You should confirm the meeting time.

lessons.title: Inviting Friends

items.example: Möchtest du ins Kino gehen?
items.exampleMeaning: Would you like to go to the cinema?

items.example: Das klingt gut für mich.
items.exampleMeaning: That sounds good to me.

items.example: Ich bin dabei, wenn du willst.
items.exampleMeaning: I am in if you want.

items.example: Leider nicht, ich habe keine Zeit.
items.exampleMeaning: Unfortunately not, I don't have time.

items.example: Was hältst du von einem Picknick?
items.exampleMeaning: What do you think of a picnic?

items.example: Lass uns einen Film schauen.
items.exampleMeaning: Let's watch a movie.

lessons.tip: When inviting someone, you can use 'Möchtest du...?' or 'Was hältst du von...?'. Both are friendly ways to ask.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Would you like to go to the cinema?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Was hältst du von einem Picknick?
dialogue.meaning: What do you think of a picnic?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Leider nicht, ich habe keine Zeit.
dialogue.meaning: Unfortunately not, I don't have time.

scenario.partnerRole: You are inviting a friend to an event.
scenario.learnerRole: You are responding to the invitation.
scenario.brief: Ask about the plan and confirm or decline.
scenario.goal: You should respond to the invitation.

lessons.title: Making Specific Plans

items.example: Wir gehen am Samstag ins Museum.
items.exampleMeaning: We are going to the museum on Saturday.

items.example: Wie wäre es mit einem Kaffee?
items.exampleMeaning: How about a coffee?

items.example: Tut mir leid, ich habe schon etwas vor.
items.exampleMeaning: Sorry, I already have plans.

items.example: Könnten wir uns später treffen?
items.exampleMeaning: Could we meet later?

items.meaning: I am looking forward to it.
items.example: Ich freue mich darauf, dich zu sehen.
items.exampleMeaning: I am looking forward to seeing you.

items.example: Das passt mir gut.
items.exampleMeaning: That works well for me.

lessons.tip: When making specific plans, use 'am' for days and 'mit' for with. For example, 'am Samstag' (on Saturday) and 'mit Freunden' (with friends).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wie wäre es mit einem Kaffee am Samstag?
dialogue.meaning: How about a coffee on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Könnten wir uns um zwei Uhr treffen?
dialogue.meaning: Could we meet at two o'clock?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am looking forward to it!

scenario.partnerRole: You are confirming plans with a friend.
scenario.brief: Suggest a day and time to meet. Confirm or change the plan.
scenario.goal: You should finalize the meeting details.

lessons.title: Replying to Invitations

items.example: Danke für die Einladung zur Party!
items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for the invitation to the party!

items.example: Ich kann kommen, wenn es um sechs Uhr ist.
items.exampleMeaning: I can come if it's at six o'clock.

items.example: Ich muss leider absagen, ich bin krank.
items.exampleMeaning: I must unfortunately decline, I am sick.

items.example: Das klingt fantastisch, ich freue mich!
items.exampleMeaning: That sounds fantastic, I am looking forward to it!

items.example: Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich kommen kann.
items.exampleMeaning: I am not sure if I can come.

items.example: Lass uns das für nächste Woche planen!
items.exampleMeaning: Let's plan that for next week!

lessons.tip: When replying to invitations, you can express gratitude with 'Danke für die Einladung!' and confirm with 'Ich kann kommen.'

dialogue.meaning: Let's plan that for next week!

scenario.partnerRole: You are responding to an invitation.
scenario.learnerRole: You are either accepting or declining the invitation.
scenario.brief: Express gratitude and confirm or decline the invitation.
scenario.goal: You should reply appropriately to the invitation.

scenario.goal: You should demonstrate understanding of making plans.
